over_refusal_control._meaning: should NOT refuse (tests the prior leg). Includes counterintuitive-but-SETTLED stress cases where a naive prior would over-refuse. Pools = captured direction_shadow doc_pmids.
over_refusal_control.criterion: factor->outcome with an ESTABLISHED consensus direction and NO genuinely-active/contested counter-paradox in CURRENT literature (a historically-counterintuitive but now-settled finding still counts as one-directional). Excludes genuinely-contested topics (metformin-CKD, HRT, alcohol, DBP J-curve, glucose-ACCORD). n=9.
